__package__.yml.rawContents:
service:
  auth: false
  base-path: ''
  endpoints:
    getPaymentSchedule:
      path: /payment_initiation/payment/get
      method: GET
      source:
        openapi: ../openapi.yml
      response:
        docs: The payment schedule
        type: nullable<ExternalPaymentScheduleGet>
        status-code: 200
      examples:
        - response:
            body:
              adjusted_start_date: '2023-01-15'
              end_date: '2023-01-15'
              interval: WEEKLY
              interval_execution_day: 1
              start_date: '2023-01-15'
    createPaymentSchedule:
      path: /payment_initiation/payment/create
      method: POST
      source:
        openapi: ../openapi.yml
      request:
        name: ExternalPaymentScheduleRequest
        body:
          properties:
            start_date: date
            interval: PaymentScheduleInterval
            interval_execution_day: integer
            end_date: optional<nullable<date>>
            adjusted_start_date: optional<nullable<date>>
            description: optional<string>
        content-type: application/json
      examples:
        - request:
            start_date: '2023-01-15'
            interval: WEEKLY
            interval_execution_day: 1
  source:
    openapi: ../openapi.yml
types:
  PaymentScheduleInterval:
    enum:
      - WEEKLY
      - MONTHLY
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
  ExternalPaymentScheduleBase:
    properties:
      interval: optional<PaymentScheduleInterval>
      interval_execution_day: optional<integer>
      start_date: optional<date>
      end_date: optional<nullable<date>>
      adjusted_start_date: optional<nullable<date>>
      description: optional<string>
    extra-properties: true
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
  ExternalPaymentScheduleGet:
    properties:
      adjusted_start_date: nullable<date>
      end_date: nullable<date>
      interval: PaymentScheduleInterval
      interval_execution_day: integer
      start_date: date
      description: optional<string>
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml

rootApiFile.rawContents:
name: api
error-discrimination:
  strategy: status-code
display-name: Payment Schedules
